_comment: Native DFT grid (WP4) references from PySCF 2.14.0 (venv ~/.venvs/qmref), scripts/qm_grid_pyscf_reference.py.

Grid: gen_atomic_grids(atom_grid=(n_rad, n_ang), prune=None) + get_partition(radii_adjust, BRAGG_RADII, becke_scheme); points re-indexed to curcuma's order (radial outer, angular inner); every 211th point stored.
Density: RHF/def2-SVP spherical, conv_tol 1e-12, conv_tol_grad 1e-9; points: [index, rho, drho/dx, drho/dy, drho/dz] in a.u.; nelec_grid = sum w rho over the whole grid.
Geometries in Bohr via 0.529177210903 (curcuma units.h). Claude Generated (Oct 2026).
